latestReleaseDescription.en:
# Smol Hatchling 2.0: Outer Wilds Scale Manipulator
Smol Hatchling has been remade from the ground up! Smol Hatchling can now be used not only by players who want to experience Outer Wilds from many different scales, but by other mod developers who may want to resize the player or other things in their mods.

## Features

### Customizable Scale for the Player, Anglerfish, the Stranger's Inhabitants, and more!
With Smol Hatchling, you can set the player character to any size you want; smaller than a marshmallow, bigger than the solar system, or anywhere in between!

It even comes with hotkeys you can use to change your scale on the fly: press the "<" key to divide your size by two, ">" to multiply it by two, and "/" to return to normal. Player properties such as their collider size, grounded raycasts, and speed are automatically tweaked to work with the Player being resized.

Smol Hatchling can be used to resize **any object** in the game. All moving creatures will have their movement speed and other attributes adjusted as well so it makes sense compared to their size! I'm planning to add adjustments for other types of objects in the future so that they will also be fully functional at different sizes!

Note: Custom Player Scale must be enabled in the config menu prior to use. Otherwise, Smol Hatchling will automatically use the default player scale or the scale set by other mods.

### API for use by other Mods
Smol Hatchling comes with an API that other mods can use to resize the Player or other objects!
latestReleaseDescription.zh:
Smol Hatchling 2.0: 星际拓荒比例操控器
Smol Hatchling 已从底层完全重制！Smol Hatchling 现在不仅可用于想要从不同比例体验星际拓荒的玩家，还可用于可能想要调整其模组中玩家或其他内容的其他模组开发者。

## 功能

### 可自定义玩家、钓鱼鱼、陌生人的居民等的比例！
使用 Smol Hatchling，你可以将玩家角色设置为任何你想要的大小；比棉花糖小，比星系大，或者介于两者之间！

它甚至提供了你可以用来即时调整比例的热键：按“<”键将你的尺寸缩小一半，按“>”键将其放大两倍，按“/”键恢复正常。玩家的属性，如它们的碰撞器大小、接地射线投射和速度，会自动调整以适应玩家尺寸的变化。

Smol Hatchling 可用于调整游戏中的**任何对象**的尺寸。所有移动生物的运动速度和其他属性也会相应调整，以便与它们的尺寸相匹配！我计划在未来添加对其他类型对象的调整，以便它们在不同尺寸下也能完全正常工作！

注意：自定义玩家比例必须在配置菜单中启用后才能使用。否则，Smol Hatchling 将自动使用默认玩家比例或由其他模组设置的比例。

### 其他模组使用的 API
Smol Hatchling 提供了一个 API，其他模组可以使用它来调整玩家或其他对象的尺寸！

latestReleaseDescription.en:
# Another revamp after the release of `1.0`. Here's what's changed:

- New `README.md` and logo (ooh, shiny). Go check it out!
- Music has been temporarily replaced until I can compose something better. I feel it wasn't polished enough.
- Skybox has been changed.
- Urath, Alpinia, Dester, and Mirtha have been given pretty clouds (they even cast shadows and go dark at night!). Should make it feel just a little more immersive.
- Optimization and bugfixing.
- Urath has had a terrain overhaul.
- New icons added to the ship log.
- **A strange new planet has appeared in the system through unknown means...**

- 音乐已被临时替换，直到我能创作出更好的。我觉得它还不够精致。
- 天空盒已更改。
- Urath、Alpinia、Dester和Mirtha获得了漂亮的云（它们甚至投射阴影，晚上会变暗！）应该让它感觉更沉浸一些。
- 优化和修复了错误。
- Urath的地形已经改版。
- 船员日志添加了新图标。
- **通过未知方式，系统中出现了一个奇怪的新行星...**

## Fixes and Improvements

### General

- Prevented a music track from playing more times than it should, and adjusted the ambience of a certain location.
- Fixed a bug where signals would break in a certain context.
- Updated the visuals of a certain sequence to more clearly indicate its location.
- Made an alarm work in a way that's consistent with others of its kind.
- A certain utility will now accurately track the occupants of a specific location.
- Fixed a bug where certain beams of light wouldn't appear as they should.
- Fixed an issue where "Unidentified Signal Nearby" would appear in the HUD despite there being no signal nearby.
- Moved an easter egg to an even less conspicuous place.

### Art

- Added the new logo to the main menu as a subtitle (thanks Classic!)

### Story and Text

- Various text corrections and improvements
- Added some additional dialogue options to Hornfels about certain topics
- Reworked a particular text log to be more relevant and clear
- Updated Japanese translation (thanks @TRSasasusu!)

### 艺术

latestReleaseDescription.en:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).

- NomaiVR compatibility work from @theCapypara :
	- A "Show Unlock Notification" setting that shows a text notification at the center of the screen whenever an item is unlocked. This is primarily intended for NomaiVR players, since the normal in-game console is difficult to read in VR.
	- Normally NomaiVR forces you to wake up facing GD, just like when you wake up in the vanilla game. The randomizer will now actively disable this "feature", since it becomes a bug when the randomizer puts you on another planet or randomizes orbits.
	- Reimplements the in-game console to follow the player's view while fixing several cases where it would fail to appear.
	- Extend NomaiVR's solution for text input fields in the main menu to also work for the in-game console.
	- Fixes NomaiVR's handling of the Translator and Signalscope, especially when ArchipelagoRandomizer prevents you from equipping them.
	- Fixes NomaiVR re-enabling the Landing Camera after ArchipelagoRandomizer disables it.
	- Edits NomaiVR's ship UI to say when the Signalscope, Scout, and Landing Camera are "not available".
- Song of the Universe tracking fixes:
	- Fixed Universal Tracker "Go Mode" for Song of the Universe goals
	- Fixed an in-game tracker bug that would cause inconsistently crashes on Song of the Universe slots
latestReleaseDescription.zh: 安装说明请参考 [README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation)。

# Resource Management v0.3.0

### Ship Emergency Thrusters
- They work about the same as your suit: When you run out of fuel, they will activate and drain oxygen at a *very* quick rate whenever you're thrusting, so watch out.

### Mod settings
- Now you can access the mod configuration from the Mods tabs in the game settings. You'll be able to customize certain parameters such as oxygen regeneration rate, or enable / disable certain functions.

### And *a* bug fix
- (Hopefully) fixed a NRE spam in console after dying / meditating


- Removed code

- 现在你可以从游戏设置的模组选项卡中访问模组配置。你将能够自定义某些参数，例如氧气再生速率，或启用/禁用某些功能。 

### 以及*一个*错误修复

latestReleaseDescription.en:
## 0.2.0

- Added support for LiveSplit.
- Added overlay destination selector: Main HUD, Landing monitor, Space suit HUD (WIP).
- Exposed **Content** folder next to the DLL (editable JSON/LSS data).
- Overlay corners moved to **RuleGuiCorners.json** (removed in-menu per-rule corner options).
- Refactored for maintainability.

Install: extract **TheIterator.PodracingTracker.zip** so PodracingTracker.dll, manifest.json, default-config.json, and **Content** sit in your mod folder (OWML mods directory for **TheIterator.PodracingTracker**).

See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/5PIterator/Podracing-Tracker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for LiveSplit setup steps.
latestReleaseDescription.zh:

- 添加了对LiveSplit的支持。

- 暴露了位于DLL旁边的**内容**文件夹（可编辑的JSON/LSS数据）。
- 覆盖层角落移动到**RuleGuiCorners.json**（删除了菜单中的每个规则的角落选项）。
- 为可维护性进行了重构。

安装：解压**TheIterator.PodracingTracker.zip**，使PodracingTracker.dll、manifest.json、default-config.json和**内容**位于您的模组文件夹中（对于**TheIterator.PodracingTracker**，在OWML模组目录中）。

latestReleaseDescription.en:
# Updated and Patches

## Dynamic Weather
* When enabled the size, density and turbulence of the volumetric clouds will change over time
* Added setting to enable or disable dynamic weather

## Volumetric Clouds
* Made volumetric cloud borders more defined hopefully making them look better
* Volumetric clouds now rotate around Timber Hearth and slowly change shape
* Added new dynamic weather setting
* Fixed weird border effect that some clouds could have
* Made clouds more white
* Made clouds taller

## New Landing Pad
* Added a new dual platform landing pad on the side of Timber Hearth's largest geyser
* Added setting to enabled or disable the new landing pad

## Trees
* Fixed tree textures not loading when spawning the trees (yes, finally)
* Added bird song to some trees (volume can be controlled in the mod settings)
latestReleaseDescription.zh:
# 更新和补丁

## 动态天气
* 启用时，体积云的大小、密度和湍流将随时间变化
* 添加了启用或禁用动态天气的设置

## 体积云
* 使体积云边界更清晰，希望能让它们看起来更好
* 体积云现在绕着木炉星旋转，并缓慢改变形状
* 添加了新的动态天气设置
* 修复了一些云可能出现的奇怪边界效果
* 使云更白
* 使云更高

## 新着陆平台
* 在木炉星最大的间歇泉旁边添加了一个新的双平台着陆平台
* 添加了启用或禁用新着陆平台的设置

## 树木
* 修复了在生成树木时树木纹理不加载的问题（是的，终于修复了）

latestReleaseDescription.en: Outer Wilds is a game loosely based on real-world astronomy and orbital physics, but as anyone who has taken a high school physics class could tell you, the game is clearly not scientifically accurate at all. A black hole that doesn't spaghettify you? Trees that produce infinite oxygen? Sand passing back and forth between two planets? These are just a few of the many scientifically inaccurate things in the game. This mod removes all of the planets that are scientifically inaccurate, leaving only the ones that are scientifically accurate. The result is a much more realistic and scientifically accurate Outer Wilds experience.
latestReleaseDescription.zh: 星际拓荒是一款基于真实世界天文学和轨道物理学的游戏，但任何上过高中物理课的人都能告诉你，这款游戏显然根本不科学。一个不会把你拉成意大利面状的黑洞？能产生无限氧气的树木？在两个行星之间来回流动的沙子？这只是游戏中许多不科学之处的几个例子。这个模组移除了所有不科学的行星，只留下那些科学的行星。结果是体验到一个更加真实和科学的星际拓荒。
